walk_script:
<script>
(function(){let st=-1,full='';
document.addEventListener('click',function(ev){const b=ev.target.closest&&ev.target.closest('[data-cc-walk]');if(!b)return;
const pane=b.closest('[data-pane]'),ta=pane.querySelector('[data-cc-editor]'),wl=pane.querySelector('[data-cc-wl]'),run=pane.querySelector('[data-cc-run]');
const title=pane.querySelector('.cctitle').textContent;
if(b.dataset.ccWalk==='0'||pane._wt!==title){pane._wt=title;full=ta.value;st=-1}
const code=full.split('\n'),ch=[];code.forEach((l,i)=>{if(l.trim()&&!/^\s/.test(l)&&!/^(else|elif|except|finally)\b/.test(l)||!ch.length)ch.push([i,i]);else ch[ch.length-1][1]=i});
if(b.dataset.ccWalk==='0'){ta.value=full;wl.hidden=false;wl.textContent='Walk through ready: '+ch.length+' blocks. Press Next block.';return}
st=Math.min(st+1,ch.length-1);const e=document.createElement('div');
wl.hidden=false;wl.innerHTML='';code.forEach((l,i)=>{const on=i>=ch[st][0]&&i<=ch[st][1],d=document.createElement('div');d.textContent=String(i+1).padStart(2)+'  '+l;d.style.cssText=on?'background:#ffe08a;color:#000':'opacity:.55';wl.appendChild(d)});
ta.value=code.slice(0,ch[st][1]+1).join('\n');ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));run.click()},true)})();
</script>
